metadata.title: NP-NCD source-bounded indicator release
metadata.boundary: Complete transcription of the monitoring manifestations identified in Annexure 9.2 of the NP-NCD Operational Guidelines 2023-2030, supplemented by the four explicitly defined population-based-screening monitoring indicators in the current official training module. Authenticated National NCD Portal dictionaries and state additions are outside this release.
